## Summary

Issue #4 requested a read-only `GET /schema` endpoint to expose the connected SQLite database structure, helping clients discover what tables and columns are queryable before crafting `/chat` queries.

- Added `GET /schema` endpoint to `main.py` reusing the existing `get_database_schema()` helper and SQLite connection pattern
- Returns JSON with table names and column info (name + type)
- Handles DB-unreachable case with HTTP 500 and a clear error message
- Updated `API_DOCUMENTATION.md` with the new endpoint

## Implementation Plan

See [specs/feature-schema-endpoint.md](specs/feature-schema-endpoint.md) for the full implementation plan.

## Key Changes

- `main.py` — added `/schema` route (~54 lines changed)
- `API_DOCUMENTATION.md` — documented the new endpoint
- `specs/feature-schema-endpoint.md` — implementation plan artifact

## Checklist

- [x] `GET /schema` endpoint added to `main.py`
- [x] Reuses existing `get_database_schema()` helper
- [x] Reuses existing SQLite connection logic
- [x] Returns JSON matching the required shape (`{"tables": [...]}`)
- [x] Handles DB-unreachable with HTTP 500
- [x] `API_DOCUMENTATION.md` updated
- [x] No changes to existing endpoints

Closes #4

---
ADW tracking ID: `68c4cc48`
EOF
)" --base main
